description: Unit tests for absl::random::uniform_int_distribution, including parameter serialization, moment calculations, chi-squared tests, and stability tests.

classes.name: UniformIntDistributionTest
classes.description: Template class for testing absl::uniform_int_distribution with various integer types.

methods.name: ParamSerializeTest
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of distribution parameters, and verifies generated sample ranges.

methods.name: ViolatesPreconditionsDeathTest
methods.description: Checks that invalid parameters cause death tests or are handled properly in debug and release modes.

methods.name: TestMoments
methods.description: Validates statistical moments (mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis) of the distribution against expected values.

methods.name: ChiSquaredTest50
methods.description: Performs a chi-squared goodness-of-fit test to verify uniformity of the distribution.

methods.name: StabilityTest
methods.description: Checks the reproducibility and stability of the distribution's output with a fixed seed.
